<!-- Generated by docs-kit refgen/help2md from --help output. Do not edit. -->

```text
Inspect applications

Usage:
  myks inspect apps [env-selector [app-selector]] [flags]

Arguments:
  env-selector    (Optional) Comma-separated list of environments or ALL
                  When omitted, all environments are processed.
                  ALL will also process all environments.
                  Examples: ALL
                            prod,stage,dev
                            prod/region1,stage/region1

  app-selector    (Optional) Comma-separated list of applications or ALL
                  When omitted, all applications are processed.
                  ALL will also process all applications.
                  Examples: ALL
                            app1,app2

Flags:
  -a, --async int                               sets the number of applications to be processed in parallel
                                                the default (0) is no limit
      --buffer-plugin-output                    buffer plugin output instead of streaming (useful for parallel execution)
      --config string                           config file (default is the first .myks.yaml up the directory tree)
      --data-values                             include final resolved ytt data values
  -h, --help                                    help for apps
  -l, --log-level string                        set the logging level (default "info")
  -o, --output string                           output format: "text" or "json" (default "text")
      --print-stats                             print tool resource statistics directly to stdout
      --provenance string[="set"]               include the file that sets each final data value and helm or ytt-pkg value; "all" also lists the myks built-in data value defaults in the text output
      --redundant                               include data values and helm or ytt-pkg values a file sets to the value it already inherits; exit non-zero if any
      --rendered                                include rendered artifacts from .myks/ if available
      --smart-mode.base-revision string         base revision to compare against in Smart Mode
                                                if not provided, only local changes will be considered
      --smart-mode.only-print string[="text"]   only print the list of environments and applications that would be rendered in Smart Mode
                                                accepted values: "text" (default), "json"
                                                legacy boolean values (true, 1, yes) are treated as "text" for backward compatibility
                                                legacy falsey values (false, 0, no) disable Smart Mode only-print (same as leaving it empty)
                                                when used without a value (--smart-mode.only-print), defaults to "text"
Examples:
  # Inspect all apps in all environments
  myks inspect apps

  # Inspect all apps in production and staging
  myks inspect apps prod,stage ALL

  # Inspect specific apps in all environments
  myks inspect apps ALL app1,app2

  # Inspect specific apps in specific environments
  myks inspect apps prod,stage app1,app2

  # Show which data-values, schema, helm or ytt-pkg values file sets each final value
  myks inspect apps prod app1 --provenance

  # Also list the values that come from the myks built-in defaults
  myks inspect apps prod app1 --provenance=all

  # Fail when a data-values, helm or ytt-pkg values file sets a value to the one it already inherits (for CI)
  myks inspect apps --redundant
```
